```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.1-2#2]

| Condition | Check for Usage of Symptom Code in Patient Consultation Requests | Action |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|--------|
| Yes        | Symptom Code used                                             | Display "Symptom Code used, cannot be deleted" |
| No         | Symptom Code not used                                         | Allow deletion of Symptom Code |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-1]

| Condition | Deployment Platform | Action |
|------------|----------------------|--------|
| Yes        | Heroku Platform      | System deployed successfully |
| No         | Any other platform   | Exception: System must be deployed on Heroku Platform |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-2]

| Condition | Stakeholder Login Status | Action |
|------------|--------------------------|--------|
| Yes        | All stakeholders logged in | Access the System via specific URL |
| No         | Any stakeholder not logged in | Prevent access to the System |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-3]

| Condition | Processor Speed | Action |
|------------|------------------|--------|
| Yes        | Pentium 4 or higher | System runs successfully |
| No         | Processor slower than Pentium 4 | Exception: Minimum processor requirement not met |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-4]

| Condition | Free Harddrive Space | Action |
|------------|----------------------|--------|
| Yes        | ≥ 100 MB            | System runs successfully |
| No         | < 100 MB            | Exception: Insufficient harddrive space |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-5]

| Condition | RAM | Action |
|------------|-----|--------|
| Yes        | ≥ 128 MB | System runs successfully |
| No         | < 128 MB | Exception: Minimum RAM requirement not met |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-6]

| Condition | Database Space | Action |
|------------|----------------|--------|
| Yes        | ≥ 1 GB        | System runs successfully |
| No         | < 1 GB        | Exception: Insufficient database space |

Decision Table for Requirement [VIRTUA-3.2-7]

| Condition | RAM | Action |
|------------|-----|--------|
| Yes        | ≥ 2 GB | System runs successfully |
| No        | < 2 GB | Exception: Minimum RAM requirement not met |
```
